measure.sourceTitle: The Best 4 Star Hotels in Paris from $113 | Expedia
measure.evidenceText: Expedia’s Paris 4-star page states that price trend information excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed properties with 4 stars in Paris. Its monthly trend table lists August at $181 per night.
measure.referencePeriod: August 2026 monthly trend; base rates for nightly stays for 2 adults found in the prior 7 days and averaged over commonly viewed 4-star properties
measure.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Paris France 4-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
measure.reason: Exact city/class, two-adult nightly trend, reference window, currency display, and explicit tax exclusion are present.
